# Investigate CSS Output

Explain why the supplied class, manifest, or config produces the observed CSS, or why that output changed.

Use [the css-output context pack](../../.ai/context/css-output.md) for task-specific guidance; repository policy remains in `AGENTS.md`. Do not reread guidance already in context.

## Completion

Report the input, matching rule and source evidence, final output explanation, validation, and any suspected bug. Change code only when the task also requests a fix.
